blocks.text: Experience the future of mobile innovation with Nothing Phone (3). Built for those who dare to be different, this flagship smartphone fuses Nothing’s signature transparent aesthetics with the raw intelligence.From the interactive Glyph Interface to the intuitive Essential Key, every detail is crafted to keep you focused and inspired. Whether you are a creative visionary or a high-performance professional, the Phone (3) seamlessly integrates into your lifestyle, offering a sophisticated, clutter-free tech experience. Camera:- Revolutionary All 50MP Quad Camera System: Main Camera, Periscope Lens, Ultra-wide Camera, Ultra-clear Front Camera- Supports Ultra XDR 4K video, Auto Tone, Portrait Optimizer, Motion Capture Mode, and Night Mode- Enhanced with AI-powered photography tools for professional-grade results—ideal for photographers, vloggers, and social media creatorsDisplay:- 6.67" FHD+ 1.5K AMOLED Flex Screen- 1.07 billion colors and 120Hz adaptive refresh rate for ultra-smooth visuals- Compared to previous models: 181.2% brighter (4500 nits), 16.7% sharper (460 PPI), and 316% faster touch response (1000Hz)Performance:- Powered by Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset with 4nm process technology- Full-core 3.2GHz CPU- 24GB LPDDR5X memory + UFS 4.0 flash storage- Integrated AI engine for intelligent performance optimizationAdditional Features:- Essential Key—dedicated side button for:- Single press: Screen capture- Long press: Voice memo recording- Double press: Access Essential Space (AI-organized hub)- Glyph Interface with interactive light matrix:- Smart animations for notifications, tools, games, and NFC triggers- Glyph Button to browse Glyph Toys and launch utilities- Light + sound alerts for smarter notifications- AI-powered organization and suggestions through Essential Space- IP68-rated for dust and water resistancePhone (3) US Carrier Compatibility:AT&T: Generally supported for normal network use.T-Mobile: Generally supported for normal network use.Verizon: Not recommended for use with the Nothing Phone (3). Full network performance and compatibility cannot be guaranteed.Additional Note:Actual network performance, including data speeds and signal strength, may vary depending on regional band availability, carrier infrastructure, and environmental conditions. A consistent full network experience cannot be guaranteed in all scenarios. For detailed band information and carrier compatibility details, please refer to the specifications page on the official website and visit our Support Centre for more information.

items.label: Ultra-high Performance Chipset
items.value: This cell phone is equipped with a powerful and efficient Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chip, using 4nm technology and a full-core 3.2GHz CPU, supporting 24GB LPDDR5X memory + UFS 4.0 flash memory, and equipped with an AI engine, with comprehensive performance upgrades.

items.label: Revolutionary 50MP Quad Camera System
items.value: This smartphone is equipped with All 50MP four camera system: Including a Main Camera, a Periscope, an Ultra-wide Camera, and a ultra-clear Front Camera; this cell phone support Ultra XDR 4K video, Auto Tone, Portrait Optimiser, Motion Capture Mode, Night Mode; Whether you're a photographer, vlogger, or social media enthusiast, with the pro-grade camera system and AI enhancements, this Nothing phone can ensure every shot is masterpiece-ready.

items.label: One-Touch Control, AI-Powered Organization：ESSENTIAL KEY
items.value: A new button on the side of your device.Press once to capture your screen, long-press to record voice and ideas, and double-press to access Essential Space; ESSENTIAL SPACE: Everything in one place, organised the way you want it to be，AI mobile phones helps organise your captures, generating suggestions, and staying on top of what matters; Explore more AI features, Let AI enrich your life

items.label: GLYPH INTERFACE
items.value: Where Light Speaks; The Glyph Matrix transforms your phone into an interactive playground—smart animations turn notifications, tools, and games into living light experiences; NFC: An animation comes to life when NFC is triggered; Glyph Button: Quick-tap to browse Glyph Toys, long-press to launch—from utilities to games; Smarter Alerts: Notifications now speak in light and sound, blending visuals with meaning; Beyond illumination; This is interaction, redefined.

items.label: Larger and Brighter FHD Display
items.value: 6.67" FHD+ 1.5K AMOLED flex screen with 1.07B colors & 120Hz adaptive refresh for ultra-smooth visuals; Vs Nothing Phone (2)/(3a): Phone (3) boasts 181.2% brighter (4500 nits), 16.7% sharper (460 PPI), and 316% faster touch response (1000Hz); IP68-rated—tough enough for any adventure.

items.label: Broad AT&T & T-Mobile Support
items.value: Fully supports voLTE, voNR, 3G, 4G, and 5G. AT&T bands (LTE: 2/4/5/12/17/26/30/48/66; 5G: n2/n5/n30/n48/n66/n77). T-Mobile bands (LTE: 2/4/12/17/25/41/66/71; 5G: n2/n12/n25/n41/n66/n71)

items.label: Limited Verizon Compatibility
items.value: Before using the Nothing Phone (3), you need to reach out to Verizon customer service to whitelist the IMEI of your device in their database. We do not recommend using the Phone (3) on the Verizon network

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Built-In GPS, Dual SIM, Fast Charging Support, Stereo Speakers, Wireless Charging
